info.title: PlayerSignal local alpha
info.description: Accounts are opt-in via AUTH_ENABLED. When enabled, game resources require a session and every mutation requires X-CSRF-TOKEN from /api/auth/session. Cross-workspace resources return 404. Local rules are the default analysis provider; paid OpenAI requires explicit opt-in. New source features require migrations V8–V12. This contract describes source, not the previously built runtime. Dynamic administrative maps use extensible object schemas.

get.summary: Download all matching imported reviews as CSV
get.description: Same language, votedUp and literal q filters as reviews. All pages; maximum 5000 rows and 10 MiB, otherwise 422 without a partial download. UTF-8 BOM, CRLF records, quoted fields, spreadsheet formula prefixes escaped with an apostrophe. No AI results, author IDs or raw payloads. Import coverage may be partial. Classification filters apply only to the current input hash/provider/model/prompt. PENDING means no current classification. Category and issue filters require SUCCEEDED.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive creation date, UTC midnight. Omitted means no lower bound. Use YYYY-MM-DD, years 0001–9999; reversed/invalid dates return 400.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive creation date, through the entire UTC day. Omitted means no upper bound. Use YYYY-MM-DD, years 0001–9999; reversed/invalid dates return 400.
